title: The rquotad daemon must be disabled on AIX.
check_content:
From the command prompt, execute the following command: 
# grep "^rquotad[[:blank:]]" /etc/inetd.conf

If there is any output from the command, this is a finding.
fixtext:
In "/etc/inetd.conf", comment out the "rquotad" entry by running command: 
# chsubserver -r inetd -C /etc/inetd.conf -d -v 'rquotad' -p 'udp'

Restart inetd:
# refresh -s inetd
VulnDiscussion: The rquotad service allows NFS clients to enforce disk quotas on file systems that are mounted on the local system. This service should be disabled if to prevent attacks.
